adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `feed_key` (lines ~20-22) computes a Redis key (`"feed-modified:..."`) but is never referenced anywhere in the job. The polling implementation always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` with no conditional request/If-Modified-Since wiring shown in the diff. So the helper is dead/vestigial code and indicates missing or abandoned change-detection support, but it does not break correctness (duplicates are mitigated by `TopicEmbed.import` using `content_sha1`).
